title: Queensland Launches Child and Youth Protection Commission
body: Queensland has established a new Child and Youth Protection Commission to centralise child safeguarding oversight across the state. The Commission will coordinate child protection efforts and strengthen safeguarding systems across all sectors, including sporting organisations. This follows recommendations from recent inquiries into child safety in Queensland.

title: Victoria Updates Child Safety Guidance for Sports Organisations
body: The Victorian Government has released updated child safety guidance for early childhood and community services, with implications for sporting clubs that work with children. The guidance clarifies obligations under the Child Safe Standards and provides practical examples of compliance. All Victorian sporting clubs should review the updated materials to ensure their policies remain current.

title: NSW Strengthens Early Childhood Compliance Framework
body: NSW has announced enhanced compliance and oversight measures for organisations working with children, including stronger enforcement of child safety requirements. While initially focused on early childhood education, the changes signal NSW's broader approach to child safety compliance that may extend to sporting organisations. Clubs should monitor developments as the compliance framework evolves.

title: Privacy Act Reforms May Impact Club Record Keeping
body: The Australian Government has released an exposure draft of Privacy Act reforms proposing significant changes to how organisations handle personal information. Sporting clubs that collect and store member data, including information about children and volunteers, should review the proposed changes. The reforms include stricter consent requirements and enhanced data protection obligations that will affect club operations.
